note: Trade art (ART-T, WAR.md "Trade"). objects[]: every single sprite (anchor = foot; tileOrigin = px of world (0, 0, 0), the footprint's top vertex: draw at that tile's top vertex minus tileOrigin). carts[]: handcart and wagon per facing (e +x, s +y, w -x, n -y: the way it is pulled), see stateNote; crew / team = tile offsets from the footprint NW corner. mules: the wagon team sheet (rows by screen direction, facingRow maps a cart facing to a row; anchors = feet). things[]: chest, strongbox, price board (one facing). piles[]: loot piles (WAR.md "Loot piles"): small / medium / large by loads, gear-heavy (mostly items) or goods-heavy (mostly loads). stalls: the market-stall chain in public/war/buildings (L1-L3); the warehouse is building `warehouse` there. Colours = tiles.json palette + palette.

carts.crewNote: two pullers, one outside each shaft, facing the way the cart faces (any class; WAR.md: one alone x0.5)

e.note: wheel loop at ~1 m/s (a man walking); speed it with the cart

n.note: wheel loop at ~1 m/s (a man walking); speed it with the cart

carts.stateNote: halted = standing, moving = the wheel strip (same tileOrigin as halted), burning = halted scorched + fx.burning (siege fire v2 fx ids at sprite px), wrecked = 0 HP (a wheel off, the bed down on that corner; cargo goes to a loot pile), burnt = wrecked by fire + fx.burnt. cargo[facing][<kind>-<half|full>]: an overlay drawn over halted / moving / burning at that sprite's tileOrigin (empty = none); kinds sacks, crates, amphorae, logs, ore, strongbox.

carts.crewNote: the driver walks at the near mule's head on the -y side, leading the team (WAR.md: a driver within 2 tiles)
carts.teamNote: two mules side by side under the yoke: draw mule sprites (trade.mules) at these tile offsets (their feet) before the wagon when the team is behind it on screen (facing w, n), after it otherwise

coin holder (200 coin a load): a store's or a stall's coin, the court's tax box; cargo kind strongbox on carts
the agora price board (WAR.md "Stalls, offers and the board"): a whitewashed notice board on a limestone base, painted rows on the +y and +x faces; placed whole (buildOrder done)
